boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces with documented study, gathering, performance, or student-organization uses.

cards.title: Settle into the Cole Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Herring-Cole Hall
cards.notes: Bring quiet work to this designated study room; individual desk work and reading are its documented academic-year use.
cards.short_summary: A historic reading room reserved by tradition for quiet individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence designates the Cole Reading Room in Herring-Cole Hall as quiet study space during the academic year, for individual desk work and reading.
cards.source_title: Room Usage Policy | St. Lawrence University
cards.access_notes: Near silence is the stated norm; it may not be reserved for purposes other than individual desk work and reading.

cards.title: Use the MacAllaster Room
cards.subtitle: Owen D. Young Library
cards.notes: Choose this named library study room when you need a dedicated place to work outside the library’s regular spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named 24-hour study space in Owen D. Young Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The St. Lawrence Libraries space directory lists the MacAllaster Room as 'Owen D. Young Library 24-Hour Study.'
cards.source_title: Explore Our Spaces | St. Lawrence University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The library identifies this as a 24-hour study space; verify current building and card-access arrangements before going.

cards.title: Work from the library mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Owen D. Young Library
cards.notes: Use the mezzanine when an open study setting suits your reading, writing, or laptop work; check library access before arrival.
cards.short_summary: An open study area on the mezzanine of Owen D. Young Library.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence Libraries identifies the Mezzanine Study Area in Owen D. Young Library as an open study space.
cards.source_title: Mezzanine Study Area | St. Lawrence University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Listed as open study space in Owen D. Young Library; confirm current library access and availability.

cards.title: Meet in Fox Seminar Room
cards.subtitle: Owen D. Young Library
cards.notes: Check the room calendar, then use this seminar room for group work when it is not reserved for a scheduled class.
cards.short_summary: A library seminar room available for non-reserved student group study.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence Libraries states that ODY 125B, the Fox Seminar Room, is available for non-reserved student group study outside regularly scheduled classes.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Library Space | St. Lawrence University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserved for regularly scheduled classes in coordination with the registrar; otherwise available for non-reserved student group study.

cards.title: Check out ODY 140B
cards.subtitle: Owen D. Young Library
cards.notes: Use the computer lab for shared project work when research and technology instruction are not occupying the room.
cards.short_summary: A library computer lab that also opens for unreserved student group study.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence Libraries says ODY 140B is used for research and technology instruction and is otherwise available for non-reserved student group study.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Library Space | St. Lawrence University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Research and technology instruction has priority; use it for group study only at other times.

cards.title: Gather at Sullivan Student Center
cards.subtitle: Student-centered campus hub
cards.notes: Meet classmates in the student center’s shared areas, keeping in mind that groups can reserve some spaces without closing them off.
cards.short_summary: A wireless-equipped center whose space-use policy gives first priority to students.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence’s room-use policy says student use has first priority in the Sullivan Student Center and identifies shared atrium, campus room, and patio spaces.
cards.source_title: Room Usage Policy | St. Lawrence University
cards.access_notes: Some spaces are reservable; the Atrium, Campus Room, and Outdoor Patio cannot be closed off to students, faculty, and staff in the building.

cards.title: Take a break on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Central campus green
cards.notes: Use this documented student space for a daytime pause, informal meetup, or outdoor reading, and route organized requests through Student Activities.
cards.short_summary: A campus green identified by the university as primarily a student space.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence’s room-use policy identifies the Quad as primarily a student space and says use requests are reviewed by Student Activities staff.
cards.source_title: Room Usage Policy | St. Lawrence University
cards.access_notes: Organized use requests are reviewed by Student Activities staff; follow current campus guidance for events.

cards.title: Catch a Java House show
cards.subtitle: 5 University Ave.
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled live show at this student-run campus venue; residents help book performers and facilitate programming.
cards.short_summary: A student-run campus entertainment venue where residents help produce live shows.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence Housing describes Java House at 5 University Ave. as an entirely student-run campus entertainment venue where residents book performers and facilitate live shows.
cards.access_notes: Attend only scheduled programming and follow venue and campus event guidance.

cards.title: Look for an Arts Annex open mic
cards.subtitle: 21 Romoda Dr.
cards.notes: Watch for resident-hosted open mics or stoop shows, then attend the announced program rather than treating the residence as drop-in space.
cards.short_summary: An arts-focused theme house whose members host open mics and front-porch shows.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence Housing says the Arts Annex at 21 Romoda Dr. is home to artists and that members host open mics and 'stoop shows' on its front porch.
cards.access_notes: This is a residence; attend announced events and respect residential access and any host instructions.

cards.title: Connect at the Black Student Union
cards.subtitle: 52 Park St.
cards.notes: Engage with the BSU’s advocacy and dialogue programming when invited or scheduled, respecting the organization’s community-centered purpose.
cards.short_summary: A named campus space for Black students and allies focused on advocacy and dialogue.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence Housing identifies the Black Student Union at 52 Park St. as committed to supporting Black students and allies and providing a space for advocacy and dialogue.
cards.access_notes: Use in accordance with BSU programming, invitations, and residential-access expectations.
